summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks whether charity or devotion is greater; Bhishma lists many kings who attained heaven through gifts, sacrifices, and acts benefiting Brahmanas.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Sivi offers the life of his beloved son to save a Brahmana, standing resolute before a sacrificial fire.
A generous king presents a vast golden umbrella and treasures to a Brahmana during a grand sacrificial rite.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows at dusk, instructing Yudhishthira while warriors gather quietly around.
